text: 中际旭创公告，公司拟以不低于人民币40亿元且不超过人民币80亿元回购股份，回购价格不超过人民币1200元/股，用于实施股权激励计划或员工持股计划。2026年9月1日，公司首次回购37.41万股，占总股本的0.0318%，成交价区间为838.16元/股至870元/股，支付总金额3.18亿元（不含交易费用）。
text_en: Zhongji Innolight announced plans to repurchase shares for no less than RMB 4 billion and no more than RMB 8 billion, at a price not exceeding RMB 1,200 per share, for equity incentive or employee stock ownership plans. On September 1, 2026, the company completed its first repurchase of 374,100 shares, representing 0.0318% of total shares, at prices ranging from RMB 838.16 to RMB 870 per share, totaling RMB 318 million (excluding transaction fees).
